The chips/powder blend was subsequently milled using a planetary ball milling machine for 48 h with a speed of 500 rpm in hardened steel vials under argon to fabricate an NC Alloy 718-5 vol.%Y2O3 powder

The chips and milled powder were consolidated thermomechanically using a procedure involving spark plasma sintering (SPS) at 960 °C, a pressure of 75 MPa and a holding time of 10 min to fabricate cylindrical powder compacts.
Then the SPSed compacts were hot extruded in steel cans at 1120 °C using an extrusion ratio of 6:1 to prepare cylindrical rods.

Samples cut from the two as-extruded rods were heat treated via solution treatment at 970 °C for 1 h followed by air cooling (AC) and then aging at 720 °C for 8 h and 620 °C for 8 h followed again by AC.
